title: Dynamics 365 ERP apps plugin for Copilot Cowork: work with finance and operations data in Cowork
summary: Hold: the risk section's environment requirement omits the supported Unified Developer Environment exception. The briefing also treats ERP MCP billing in Cowork as unresolved even though the Cowork documentation explicitly applies the published MCP licensing rules. The control endpoints exist; the spending-policy note needs its deciding request properties.
